_comment: Modelling conventions a family's checkpoint does not state anywhere: not in config.json, not in its tensor names or shapes.
Everything that IS stated is read from the checkpoint; this file only fills the residue, keyed by model_type.
Each fact applied is recorded in the container's surface provenance, so it is never a silent guess.
Extend support to a new family that follows a known convention by adding one entry here; no code changes.
Set AMQL_CONVENTIONS to a JSON file of the same shape to add or override entries without rebuilding.
norm_weight_offset  1 when RMSNorm multiplies by (1 + w) rather than w (zero-centred norm weights).
embed_scale         'sqrt_hidden' when embeddings are multiplied by sqrt(hidden_size).
rope_interleaved    true when rotary pairs are adjacent dims (2i, 2i+1), the GPT-J layout.
partial_rotary      'zero_tail' when a partial rotary keeps the full head dim's frequency progression and zeroes the tail.
rope_on_full_layers false when, in a stack with sliding layers, the full-attention layers use no position encoding.
